tasks.title: Conversation #17
tasks.transcript:
Woman: Are you still interested in taking that nature writing workshop with me on Sunday?
Man: It's at 9.30 right, at Morvin Park?
Woman: Yes, 9.30AM, but the location within the park has changed. East Pavilion has been rented out for a private function, so they'll use the open field by Lake Hayden instead.
Man: That field is going to be hot. It's in the full sun. The workshop is early enough though. Do you know who's teaching it?
Woman: Well, Erwin Pavo is affiliated with the Morvin Park Commission. He's a very accomplished author.

questions.stem: What is mentioned about the original location of the workshop?

options.B: It is too far from the lake.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于工作坊原先的地点提到了什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士对原地点变化原因的直接说明。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 男士提到新的地点（湖边空地）会很热（That field is going to be hot），而非原先的地点，属于张冠李戴。 选项B：错误。 对话中并未比较地点与湖的距离远近，属于无中生有。 选项C：正确。 女士明确说“East Pavilion has been rented out for a private function”，即原先的地点东展馆已被租出去用于私人活动，因此无法再使用。 选项D：错误。 对话中完全没有提到地点大小的问题，属于无关干扰。

questions.stem: What does the woman imply when she says, "Well, Erwin Pavo is affiliated with the Morvan Park Commission"?

options.A: Mr. Pavo will be the instructor.
options.B: Mr. Pavo will contact the participants.
options.C: Mr. Pavo has rented the East Pavilion.
options.D: Mr. Pavo has sponsored the event.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士说“Erwin Pavo is affiliated with the Morvin Park Commission”时暗示了什么，属于推理判断题，需结合上文男士问“谁教这门课”来理解这句话的言外之意。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 男士问“Do you know who's teaching it?”，女士回答中提到Erwin Pavo与Morvin公园委员会有合作关系，并且说“He's a very accomplished author”，暗示他就是这门课的授课老师。 选项B：错误。 对话中没有提到Pavo会联系参与者，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 租用东展馆的是私人活动，而非Pavo先生，属于张冠李戴。 选项D：错误。 对话中未提到Pavo赞助了此次活动，属于与原文无关的干扰项。
